title: Node recorder does not validate observations against JSON Schema (no `ajv` in dependencies)
what: Observations are checked structurally (required fields, input kinds) only. There is no JSON Schema validator in the dependencies, so `spec/schemas/observation.json` is not fully validated.
why: DECISIONS.md E4 Vitest adapter decisions: known gap — no JSON Schema validator in dependencies.
impact: Malformed observations may not be caught until they reach the engine.
workaround: Add `ajv` as a dependency (requires a DECISIONS.md entry per PLAN rule 9).
